emily: Quick alignment  we need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch blog + a slightly more technical heatmap for the webinar appendix. Core story: predictable latency at predictable unit cost across deployment options. Prefer a concise hero visual for the post.
aj: Agreed. Hero visual should be one scatter: p95 latency (ms) on y vs $/1k tokens on x. Highlight three user archetypes with callouts: chat (low latency, mid cost), batch-summarization (higher latency tolerance, lower cost), embeddings at scale (low cost but depends on batching). Keep legend simple. :pushpin:
pete: For the webinar appendix, Ill produce a heatmap: batch-size (x) vs sequence-length (y) -> $/token (color). We can overlay dashed lines for typical deployments (hosted vs dedicated). Quick snippet to generate from the perf CSV:```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('perf_slices_euc1.csv')
heat = df.pivot_table(index='seq_len', columns='batch_size', values='cost_per_token', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(heat, cmap='viridis')
plt.xlabel('batch size')
plt.ylabel('sequence length')
plt.title('Batch x Seq -> $/token (eu-central-1, model: gpt-open-3b-q8)')
```
zara: Copy angle for the hero: short + product-forward. Options: 1) "Latency you can plan for." 2) "Serving with predictable economics." 3) "Ship faster, spend smarter." Leaning to 3 for PLG social, 2 for enterprise ops.
nina: Landing page ask flow: two radio options  "Small teams / self-serve" and "Enterprise / SLA & security". If Enterprise selected, route to AE and request region + expected QPS in the form. Add UTM param for webinar registrants.
